thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] service=embed-service severity=page P95 latency spike >2s for 3m across prod-us-west. Alerts: 3 failing health checks, increased 5xx. CC: #eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Liam: got it, I'm onpager. looking at metrics and recent deploys. can someone grab the runbook?
Devon: pulling logs now. no deploys in last 30m. I see KV cache evictions spiking on node rwd-gpu-7. hitting disk thrash maybe. snippet:
```
WARN kvcache - large-eviction: 512MB evicted in 10s - pressure=0.87
ERROR inference - decode latency 2100ms seq=512 model=gptx-64
```
Priya: paging infra to confirm node health. @Liam if you want short-term mitigation, we can reroute traffic off rwd-gpu-7 to the spare pool.
Liam: yes please. reroute + scale spare pool + disable batching on affected route to avoid compounding. I'll update status.
deploy-bot: reroute initiated -> traffic policy applied: route embed-service/us-west away from rwd-gpu-7 to pool spare-gpus-2.
Liam: mitigation in progress. latency dropping to ~800ms now. still seeing elevated 5xx for some customers. tracking customer impacts.
Sophia: customer-impact check: two customers (acme-inc, learnly) reported slow embeddings in support. CS is triaging and will notify SLAs.
Devon: root cause hypothesis: KV cache garbage collector thrash when combined with large concurrent requests (seq len ~512). there's a known GC bug on older runtime=1.3.1. Canary shows GC loop hitting disk I/O.
Priya: infra confirms rwd-gpu-7 has I/O queueing from kernel-level swap activity. node will be cordoned for deeper inspection.
Liam: ok preparing handoff to night shift. @Juno can you start a post-incident thread and schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow? Need owners, timelines, and action items.
Juno: starting post-incident doc now. proposed postmortem: tomorrow 10:30am PT, 60m, Zoom + recording. I'll create a doc and add invite.
Evan: I can own triage of runtime versions across fleet. action item: inventory nodes running runtime <1.3.3 and schedule rolling upgrade.
Devon: action item: short-term patch to disable old GC path in runtime 1.3.1. I'll open a PR and test in staging. ETA EOD.
Priya: action item: improve node-level swap/kick detection and auto-drain before severe IO. I'll add a monitor and a playbook.
Liam: log action items into incident tracker. we also need a customer communication draft for Acme and Learnly, Sophia can finalize.
Sophia: drafting customer note now, will send to legal + account for review before we push.
Juno: postmortem doc link: https://docs.internal/reports/1760123456-post-incident-embed-kvcache (please add notes). I'll keep a running timeline.
incident-bot: Reminder: create RCA and link to postmortem doc within 24h.
Maria: night handoff: I'm taking over at 19:00 PT. current mitigation: traffic rerouted, rwd-gpu-7 cordoned, spare pool scaled +1. please add any context I need.
Liam: notes for handoff -> watch for regressions when we re-enable batching, don't reintroduce rwd-gpu-7 until kernel swap disabled and runtime patched.
Maria: acknowledged. I'll monitor error rates and CPU/io charts. ping me in thread if anything changes.
Juno: postmortem agenda draft in doc: 1) timeline & impact, 2) root cause hypothesis, 3) mitigations & rollbacks, 4) action items + owners, 5) prevention patterns + training.
Evan: suggestion: we should run a brown-bag next week on KV cache sizing and runtime GC behavior. propose Wed 11am PT. I can present a quick runbook and demo.
Devon: +1. include examples of sequences that cause thrash and best batching configs.
Sophia: count me in to outline how we surface customer impact in playbooks.
Juno: I'll schedule brown-bag and invite eng, sres, and support. linking action items to the learning session.
Liam: quick TODO recap in thread: 
- Devon: PR for GC-disable patch (ETA EOD)
- Evan: Fleet runtime inventory (ETA tomorrow EOD)
- Priya: node-swap monitor + auto-drain playbook (ETA 3 days)
- Sophia: customer comms draft (ETA 2 hours)
- Juno: postmortem doc + calendar invite (ETA 1 hour)
- Maria: night monitoring + handoff notes (ongoing)
Juno: will convert these into tracker tickets and link back.
Maria: verifying mitigation still holding at 22:30 PT. error rates back to baseline. I'll keep watch.
Liam: thanks team. follow-ups: once we have the patch and inventory, schedule a controlled restart of affected nodes in a maintenance window. we'll cover process in the brown-bag.
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. Severity lowered to advisory.
Juno: postmortem meeting confirmed: 2026-03-17 11:00 PT, Zoom: https://zoom.internal/pm-1760123456. Recording will be in doc. Please add pre-read notes to the doc before meeting.
Evan: I'll prep slides showing cache eviction telemetry and a checklist for safe batching.
Devon: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pulls/789 - patch disables legacy GC path behind flag + integration tests.
Priya: monitor created: proc.swap.rate > 0.5 for 2m -> auto-drain node. playbook stub: https://runbooks.internal/auto-drain-on-swap
Sophia: customer messages sent to account teams for Acme and Learnly. CS will follow up.
Juno: closing summary: mitigation successful, short-term reroute worked, root cause likely GC + swap interaction on older runtime. postmortem + brown-bag scheduled. owners assigned. thanks all. :tada:
